description: Intent i006 (SNAPSHOT=s02, branch=xsk-umem-rereads) concluded with an evidence-backed negative result. Searched all of net/xdp (xsk.c, xsk_queue.c/h, xdp_umem.c), include/net/xdp_sock.h, include/uapi/linux/if_xdp.h, and both AF_XDP driver consumers in s02 (i40e_xsk.c, ixgbe_xsk.c). Every UMEM-resident fetch in this tree is funneled through xskq_validate_desc() (net/xdp/xsk_queue.h:193, '*desc = READ_ONCE(ring->desc[idx]);') and xskq_validate_addr() (xsk_queue.h:96, '*addr = READ_ONCE(ring->desc[idx]) & q->chunk_mask;'), which snapshot the shared descriptor once into a local; validation (xskq_is_valid_desc/xskq_is_valid_addr) and every consumer (xsk_generic_xmit xsk.c:233-259, xsk_umem_consume_tx xsk.c:173-197, i40e/ixgbe alloc_buffer_zc and xmit_zc) operate on that same local copy, so validated-equals-used holds by construction; grep confirms no direct 'ring->desc' access outside xsk_queue.h. Key counterevidence: s02 is an early AF_XDP tree with no TX metadata support at all — xsk_skb_metadata(), struct xsk_tx_metadata, XDP_TXMD_FLAGS_CHECKSUM, tx_metadata_len, and tx_sw_csum do not exist anywhere in the tree, so the seed mechanism's surface is absent. xdp_desc.options (include/uapi/linux/if_xdp.h:97) is defined but never read anywhere in net/xdp (unresolved candidate, no consumer). Limitations: search bounded to the AF_XDP surface of s02; desc.len is not checked against chunk size in s02's xskq_is_valid_desc and non-AF_XDP double-fetch surfaces belong to intents i007-i009. Findings list is empty; full evidence in agent-state/findings/i006.json.
